name: The Nayabella Condominium
shortDescription: A new six-storey condominium in Nai Yang with one-bedroom apartments, reported by a broker listing as a Rhom Bho Property project.
description:
The Nayabella Condominium is a new condominium in Nai Yang on Phuket's northwest coast. A broker listing describes a six-storey building of one-bedroom apartments on floors 2 to 6, open to foreign buyers, with Phuket International Airport about 5 to 10 minutes away by car and Bang Tao and Laguna about 20 minutes.

The same listing names Rhom Bho Property as developer and lists a swimming pool, fitness, coworking, sauna, 24/7 security, Wi-Fi and parking. It is also called The Title Nayabella. Prices, unit sizes, ownership type, payment terms and the completion date had not been published, so confirm them with us before relying on this page.

Message us on WhatsApp for the current details.
